messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: paging to @alex (oncall) for svc-model-serving-us-west1 — error-rate spike > 5% in last 5m. Auto-escalation in 3m. Link: https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/serving-cluster-us-west1

alex (oncall): seeing the spike, tailing logs now. p95 latency also creeping up. Initial thought: node restarts + autoscaler thrash?

marta: i'm jumping in. any customer-facing 5xx? we should check ingress logs + front proxy.

alex (oncall): ingress 5xxs are up (~1.8% -> 6.2%), errors tagged as "kv-cache-miss" and "kv-timeout" in model-runtime. No obvious config change.

ryan: I see a correlated increase in queue_depth and worker OOMs on host-gpu-07. Stack shows repeated GC and then OOM kill.

alex (oncall): mitigation step 1: remove host-gpu-07 from rotation (cordon), bump replica count for model-router to absorb traffic. Doing now.

ops-robo: @alex cordon completed: host-gpu-07 -> DRAINING. Autoscaler will not schedule new pods there.

jean: note for handoff: any client throttling or degraded responses? customer support triage says a handful of user-facing timeouts for high-throughput customers. No mass outage but latency is visible.

marta: ok let's do temporary alert tuning to reduce noise while we stabilize. Proposal: mute the per-host OOM alarm for 30m and raise error-rate threshold to 7% for the cluster-level pager. Thoughts?

ryan: agree on muting noisy per-host alarms, but keep a hard threshold for sustained error-rate > 10% over 15m still paged. Also create a short-lived dashboard panel to watch top error buckets.

alex (oncall): doing the alert changes now:
```bash
# mute rule
allow_alert silence add --rule "gpu-host-oom" --duration 30m --reason "investigating OOM on host-gpu-07"
# raise cluster error-rate threshold
alertctl update svc-model-serving-error-rate --threshold 0.07 --window 5m --temp-ttl 30m
```

oncall-bot: Confirmed: silence applied to gpu-host-oom for 30m. svc-model-serving-error-rate threshold updated to 7% for 30m.

marta: while we have eyes on it, we should sketch a Grafana dashboard for the post-incident retro. Key panels I'd want: cluster error-rate (by error-tag), per-model p50/p95 latency, host OOMs, queue depth, token throughput, autoscaler scale events, and a drilldown to traces/logs. Also add a small panel showing active silences and temporary alert config.

jean: +1. Also include a golden-signals panel (latency, errors, traffic, saturation) with quick links that jump to the relevant traces and pod logs. For drilldowns: clicking an error bucket should open a filtered Loki query and a Trace ID search.

ryan: i'll mock up a minimal panel JSON for the error-rate by tag so we can paste into Grafana quickly.
```json
{"type":"graph","title":"error-rate by tag","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (error_tag)(rate(model_errors_total[1m]))"}],"links":[{"url":"https://grafana.redwood/explore?orgId=1&query=$__error_query","title":"open explore"}],"datasource":"prometheus"}
```

marta: perfect. Let's also add a small note panel with runbook steps (cordon, bump replicas, throttle customers if needed). We'll add owner fields for each panel so oncall snapshots show who to ping in the retro.

alex (oncall): I'm going to hand this to marta at 2245680200 UTC — marta you take lead for remediation and dashboard build. I'll stay available for escalations.

marta: taking lead. First pass dashboard will live under "incidents/retros/serving-us-west1-2245678901". Will add panels and create a follow-up PR for perms + dashboard provisioning.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from alex (oncall) -> marta at 2245680200.

ryan: monitoring note for postmortem: consider changing metric for OOMs to a rate with host cardinality and add a debounce so transient noise doesn't fire. Also add an aggregation fallback that pages only when both error_rate and host_oom_rate cross thresholds.

jean: agreed. action items: 1) dashboard draft by marta within 2 hours, 2) revert temp alert thresholds after stability window, 3) post-incident retro to finalize permanent alert tuning (debounce/aggregation), 4) add drilldown links and runbook into dashboard.

marta: starting dashboard now. ping me if you want to test a panel query or link. I'll post the dashboard JSON when ready for review. :memo: :eyes:

alex (oncall): thanks team — i'll follow up in the retro to capture customer impact numbers once support slices logs.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated (host-cordon + replica bump) — monitoring for 30m. Silence expires at 2245681700.
